s: Din sheliach tzibbur shettaa ubo d' seipim: sheliach tzibbur shettaa vedilleg achat mikkol habberakot ukeshemmazkirin oto yodea lachazor limqomo — en mesalleqin oto min hatteba, ella chozer lammaqom shettaa kemo yachid hattoeh. Abal im dilleg "birkat hamminim" — mesalleqin oto mehatteba miyyad veen mamtinim lo ad sheyyazkiruhu, ki shemma nizreqa bo minut veeno rotzeh leqallel atzmo laken dilleg beraka zo. Umikkol maqom, en mesalleqin oto millihyot sheliach tzibbur mishshum paam achat, kevan sheyyesh lomar shettaa. Veim hitchil bah vetaa — en mesalleqin oto mehatteba. Veken im dilleg rosh habberaka vesiyyem chatimatah — en mesalleqin oto, ella chozer lerosh habberaka. Veken im lo ratza lomar "velakkoperim" ella "velammalshinim" — en mesalleqin oto, mippene sheyyesh meqomot sheomerim lekattechilla velammalshinim:

Sheliach tzibbur shettaa veeno yodea lachazor limqomo — yaabor acher tachtayv, velo yihyeh sorban beotah shaa kemo shennitbaer besiman n"g. Umatchil mittechillat habberaka shettaa zeh im haya hattaut baemtzaiyyot, velo day sheyyachazor lammaqom sheppasaq rishon, mippene shei epshar lechalleq beraka achat lishnayim. Veim haya hattaut beg' rishonot — matchil barosh, ubeg' acharonot — matchil baaboda, sheg' rishonot chashubot keachat, veken g' acharonot, kemo shennitbaer besiman qy"d:

Kol maqom shehayyachid chozer umitpallel — sheliach tzibbur chozer umitpallel im taa kemoto keshemmitpallel beqol ram, chutz mishshacharit shel rosh chodesh o shel shabbat veyom tob, sheim taa sheliach tzibbur velo hizkir shel rosh chodesh o shel shabbat veyom tob — en machazirin oto mippene torach hatztzibbur, shehare tepillat hammusapin lepanayv, shehu mazkir bah shel rosh chodesh veshel shabbat veyom tob. Vehu shello nizkar ad shehishlim tepillato, sheddino lachazor larosh veyesh bazeh torach hatztzibbur. Abal im nizkar qodem shehishlim tepillato — chozer laaboda im hu rosh chodesh (o libraka emtzait shel shabbat veyom tob), sheen bazeh torach tzibbur kol kak. Veyachid shello hizkir rosh chodesh beshacharit venizkar apillu achar shehishlim tepillato — tzarik lachazor ap al pi shettepillat hammusapin lepanayv. Umikkol maqom im lo chazar ad achar shehitpallel musap — en tzarik shub lachazor ulehitpallel shacharit, sheen lehachamir bediabad leyachid millekattechilla larabbim:

Im taa sheliach tzibbur keshehitpallel belachash — leolam eno chozer umitpallel shenit belachash mippene torach hatztzibbur, ella somek al hattepilla sheyyitpallel beqol ram. Vehu shello taa beg' rishonot, sheim taa bahen leolam chozer kemo shechozer hayyachid. Veyesh meqillin ap beg' rishonot. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem keshello nizkar ad achar shehishlim tepillato sheen tzarik lachazor larosh mippene torach tzibbur, abal im nizkar qodem shehishlim — en bachazarato torach kol kak:
